###Functional enrichment of ANOVA DEG lost with contamination

```{r}
# Use lost_DE_genes as input (single vector)
input_genes <- lost_DE_genes  # Genes that lost significance after contamination

## Background genes = all genes tested in the DE analysis
bg_genes <- unique(rownames(counts_matrix_filtered))  # Keep your existing background

## -----------------------------------------
## 1) Get MSigDB gene sets (KEEP ALL SAME)
## -----------------------------------------
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)

m_C8 <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C8")
m_C2_CP <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP")
m_C5_BP <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")

m_sel <- bind_rows(m_C8, m_C2_CP, m_C5_BP)
pathways_all <- split(m_sel$gene_symbol, m_sel$gs_name)
pw_meta <- unique(m_sel[, c("gs_name", "gs_collection", "gs_subcollection")])
colnames(pw_meta)[colnames(pw_meta) == "gs_collection"]    <- "gs_cat"
colnames(pw_meta)[colnames(pw_meta) == "gs_subcollection"] <- "gs_subcat"
```

```{r}
## -----------------------------------------
## 2) Enrichment function (KEEP SAME)
## -----------------------------------------
enrich_one_list <- function(gene_list, bg = bg_genes, pathways = pathways_all, meta = pw_meta) {
  gene_list <- intersect(gene_list, bg)
  res_list <- lapply(names(pathways), function(pw) {
    gs <- intersect(pathways[[pw]], bg)
    k <- length(intersect(gene_list, gs))
    K <- length(gs)
    n <- length(gene_list)
    N <- length(bg)
    p <- phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
    data.frame(pathway = pw, k = k, K = K, n = n, N = N, pval = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  res <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  res$padj <- p.adjust(res$pval, "BH")
  if (!is.null(meta)) {
    res <- merge(res, meta, by.x = "pathway", by.y = "gs_name", all.x = TRUE)
  }
  res[order(res$padj), ]
}
```

```{r}
## -----------------------------------------
## 3) Compute enrichment for lost_DE_genes (SINGLE LIST - Case B)
## -----------------------------------------
enr_raw <- enrich_one_list(
  gene_list = input_genes,  # lost_DE_genes
  bg = bg_genes,
  pathways = pathways_all,
  meta = pw_meta
)

## -----------------------------------------
## 4) Filter results
## -----------------------------------------
filter_enrich <- function(res, min_k = 2, max_padj = 0.05) {
  subset(res, k >= min_k & padj <= max_padj)
}

enr_filt <- filter_enrich(enr_raw, min_k = 1, max_padj = 0.5)
enr_filt <- enr_filt[order(-enr_filt$k), ]

## Results:
print(head(enr_filt, 20))
```


###Functional Enrichment for not contaminated and contaminated genes per organ ANCOVA

```{r}
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GO.db)

# Background genes
bg_genes <- unique(rownames(counts_matrix_filtered))

# 1. MSigDB gene sets (C8, C2_CP, C5_BP)
m_C8 <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C8")
m_C2_CP <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP")
m_C5_BP <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")
m_sel <- bind_rows(m_C8, m_C2_CP, m_C5_BP)
pathways_all <- split(m_sel$gene_symbol, m_sel$gs_name)
pw_meta <- unique(m_sel[, c("gs_name", "gs_collection", "gs_subcollection")])
colnames(pw_meta) <- c("gs_name", "gs_cat", "gs_subcat")

# 2. Enrichment function (unchanged)
enrich_one_list <- function(gene_list, bg = bg_genes, pathways = pathways_all, meta = pw_meta) {
  gene_list <- intersect(gene_list, bg)
  res_list <- lapply(names(pathways), function(pw) {
    gs <- intersect(pathways[[pw]], bg)
    k <- length(intersect(gene_list, gs))
    K <- length(gs); n <- length(gene_list); N <- length(bg)
    p <- phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
    data.frame(pathway = pw, k = k, K = K, n = n, N = N, pval = p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  res <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  res$padj <- p.adjust(res$pval, "BH")
  merge(res, meta, by.x = "pathway", by.y = "gs_name", all.x = TRUE)[order(res$padj), ]
}

filter_enrich <- function(res, min_k = 1, max_padj = 0.05) {
  subset(res, k >= min_k & padj <= max_padj)
}
```

```{r}
# 3. Run MSigDB enrichment PER ORGAN for both models
msigdb_no_covar <- lapply(no_covar_lists, function(genes) {
  raw <- enrich_one_list(genes)
  filter_enrich(raw)
})
msigdb_no_covar <- lapply(msigdb_no_covar, function(x) x[order(-x$k), ])

msigdb_with_covar <- lapply(with_covar_lists, function(genes) {
  raw <- enrich_one_list(genes)
  filter_enrich(raw)
})
msigdb_with_covar <- lapply(msigdb_with_covar, function(x) x[order(-x$k), ])
```


```{r}
# 4. GO enrichment function (with dplyr::select)
get_GO_common <- function(genes_symbol, min_genes = 1, min_level = 3, max_level = 50) {
  eg <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = genes_symbol, keytype = "SYMBOL", columns = "ENTREZID") |>
    distinct() |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
  if (nrow(eg) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  go_tab <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = eg$ENTREZID, keytype = "ENTREZID", 
                   columns = c("SYMBOL","GO","ONTOLOGY")) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(GO), ONTOLOGY == "BP")
  if (nrow(go_tab) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  go_common <- go_tab |> 
    dplyr::group_by(GO) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(SYMBOL), genes = paste(sort(unique(SYMBOL)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n_genes)) |> 
    dplyr::filter(n_genes >= min_genes)
  
  if (nrow(go_common) == 0) return(NULL)
  go_common$term <- Term(go_common$GO)
  go_common$level <- sapply(as.list(GOBPANCESTOR[go_common$GO]), function(x) if(is.null(x)) 1L else length(x) + 1L)
  go_common |> dplyr::filter(level >= min_level, level <= max_level)
}
```

```{r}
# 5. Run GO enrichment PER ORGAN for both models
go_no_covar <- lapply(no_covar_lists, get_GO_common)
go_with_covar <- lapply(with_covar_lists, get_GO_common)
```

```{r}

# Summary table for WITH COVAR only
summary_table_wc <- data.frame(
  Organ = names(msigdb_with_covar),
  MSigDB_WC = sapply(msigdb_with_covar, nrow),
  GO_WC = sapply(go_with_covar, nrow)
)
print("Enrichment Summary (With Contamination only):")
print(summary_table_wc)

# Quick peek at top hits WITH COVAR across all organs
lapply(names(msigdb_with_covar)[1:8], function(organ_name) {
  organ <- gsub("_with_covar", "", organ_name)
  list(
    organ = organ,
    top_msigdb = head(msigdb_with_covar[[organ_name]], 3)$pathway,
    top_go = head(go_with_covar[[organ_name]], 3)$term
  )
})

lapply(names(msigdb_no_covar)[1:8], function(organ_name) {
  organ <- gsub("_no_covar", "", organ_name)
  list(
    organ = organ,
    top_msigdb = head(msigdb_no_covar[[organ_name]], 3)$pathway,
    top_go = head(go_no_covar[[organ_name]], 3)$term
  )
})

```

###Functional Enrichment for contaminated models for DEGs for both ANCOVA and DESeq2

```{r}
# 3. Run MSigDB enrichment PER ORGAN

msigdb_with_covar <- lapply(both_sig_per_organ, function(genes) {
  raw <- enrich_one_list(genes)
  filter_enrich(raw)
})
msigdb_with_covar <- lapply(msigdb_with_covar, function(x) x[order(-x$k), ])

msigdb_no_covar <- lapply(both_sig_per_organ, function(genes) {
  raw <- enrich_one_list(genes)
  filter_enrich(raw)
})
msigdb_no_covar <- lapply(msigdb_no_covar, function(x) x[order(-x$k), ])
```


```{r}
# 4. GO enrichment function (with dplyr::select)
get_GO_common <- function(genes_symbol, min_genes = 1, min_level = 3, max_level = 50) {
  eg <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = genes_symbol, keytype = "SYMBOL", columns = "ENTREZID") |>
    distinct() |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
  if (nrow(eg) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  go_tab <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = eg$ENTREZID, keytype = "ENTREZID", 
                   columns = c("SYMBOL","GO","ONTOLOGY")) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(GO), ONTOLOGY == "BP")
  if (nrow(go_tab) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  go_common <- go_tab |> 
    dplyr::group_by(GO) |> 
    dplyr::summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(SYMBOL), genes = paste(sort(unique(SYMBOL)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n_genes)) |> 
    dplyr::filter(n_genes >= min_genes)
  
  if (nrow(go_common) == 0) return(NULL)
  go_common$term <- Term(go_common$GO)
  go_common$level <- sapply(as.list(GOBPANCESTOR[go_common$GO]), function(x) if(is.null(x)) 1L else length(x) + 1L)
  go_common |> dplyr::filter(level >= min_level, level <= max_level)
}
```
